summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a legal opinion from Meitar Law Offices regarding the validity of up to $53.9 million in ordinary shares to be sold under an existing Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement (ATM program) with Cantor Fitzgerald and Mizuho, utilizing a shelf registration statement on Form F-3. The filing is a routine procedural step in an at-the-market offering, not a special situation event. No transaction terms, premium, or structural changes are disclosed. The filing confirms continuation of a pre-existing equity distribution program with approximately half the capacity still available for future sales.
